name: Ray
description: Open-source unified framework for scaling AI and Python applications. Powers distributed training with Ray Train reinforcement learning with RLlib serving with Ray Serve and hyperparameter tuning with Ray Tune.
best_for: Multi-node parallel training, distributed serving, hyperparameter tuning, RL
pricing_notes: Ray OSS free; Anyscale Platform from $0.05/CPU-hour managed
tags: ray distributed-training serving rl hyperparameter-tuning scaling anyscale mlops

name: DeepSpeed
description: Deep learning optimization library that makes distributed training and inference of large models easy efficient and effective. Powers ZeRO memory optimization for training 100B+ parameter models.
best_for: Large model training, ZeRO memory optimization, trillion-parameter training, LLM fine-tuning
tags: deepspeed microsoft zero-optimization llm training large-model distributed memory

name: Horovod
description: Distributed deep learning training framework for TensorFlow Keras PyTorch and Apache MXNet. Created by Uber and uses ring-allreduce algorithm for efficient communication between GPUs.
best_for: Multi-GPU distributed training, data parallelism across clusters, TF+PyTorch
pricing_notes: Completely free and open-source; cloud GPU costs apply
tags: horovod distributed training data-parallel multi-gpu allreduce uber tensorflow pytorch

name: Megatron-LM
description: NVIDIA's research framework for efficient training of large-scale transformer language models. Powers model parallelism tensor parallelism and pipeline parallelism to train trillion-parameter models on GPU clusters.
best_for: Trillion-parameter LLM pre-training, NVIDIA GPU clusters, model parallelism research
pricing_notes: Free and open-source; NVIDIA GPU hardware required
tags: megatron nvidia llm large-model pre-training tensor-parallelism pipeline GPU

name: Dask
description: Flexible parallel computing library for analytics. Scales NumPy pandas and scikit-learn workflows to multi-core machines and distributed clusters without major code changes. Python-native parallelism.
best_for: Scaling Pandas/NumPy/sklearn to clusters, data engineering, distributed ML preprocessing
pricing_notes: Free OSS; Coiled managed cloud from $0.10/hour
tags: dask parallel distributed pandas numpy sklearn data-engineering preprocessing clusters

name: PyTorch Distributed (DDP/FSDP)
description: Native distributed training capabilities in PyTorch including Distributed Data Parallel (DDP) and Fully Sharded Data Parallel (FSDP). The de facto standard for multi-GPU PyTorch training.
best_for: Native PyTorch multi-GPU training, FSDP for large models, DDP for data parallelism
pricing_notes: Free via PyTorch; GPU compute is the cost
tags: pytorch ddp fsdp distributed training multi-gpu meta data-parallel model-parallel

name: ColossalAI
description: Unified deep learning system for large AI model training with high efficiency and low cost. Provides auto-parallelism optimized memory management and integrated systems for training 100B+ parameter models.
best_for: Large model training optimization, memory-efficient LLM training, research
pricing_notes: Free and open-source; HPC-AI offers commercial support
tags: colossalai distributed large-model training memory-efficient auto-parallelism hpc

name: Apache Spark MLlib
description: Apache Spark's scalable machine learning library. Provides distributed implementations of classification regression clustering collaborative filtering dimensionality reduction and feature extraction.
best_for: Distributed ML on large datasets, Spark-native feature engineering, enterprise ETL to ML
pricing_notes: Free OSS; Databricks/EMR add enterprise managed services
tags: spark mllib distributed ml classification regression clustering feature-engineering
